section: Reports and indices - releasing agency, India's rank, key findings

accepted.s: The Global Innovation Index is released by which organisation?
accepted.x: The Global Innovation Index is released by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO).
accepted.tq: Direct organisation–report recall.

accepted.s: Which institution has been designated as India's nodal body for improving India's rank in the Global Innovation Index?
o: Indian Council of Social Science Research
accepted.x: NITI Aayog is India's nodal body for improving the country's ranking in the Global Innovation Index.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the releasing organisation from the national nodal body.

accepted.s: The Logistics Performance Index is released by the
accepted.x: The World Bank releases the Logistics Performance Index.
accepted.tq: Direct report–publisher identification.

accepted.s: With reference to the Climate Risk Index and the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI), which one of the following is correct?
o: The Climate Risk Index is released by UNDP, while CCPI is released by Germanwatch.
The Climate Risk Index is released by the World Bank, while CCPI is released by ILO.
Both are released by the World Economic Forum.
accepted.x: Germanwatch releases both the Climate Risk Index and the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI).
accepted.tq: Discriminate between two similarly themed indices by their common publisher.

accepted.s: Germanwatch, associated with the Climate Risk Index and CCPI, is headquartered in which place and was established in which year?
accepted.x: Germanwatch is based in Bonn and was established in 1991.
accepted.tq: Combine the organisation's location and establishment year in a numerical recall question.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Global Wage Report is released by the International Labour Organization, not UNCTAD. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped releasing agency among closely related reports.

accepted.s: The Human Development Index and the Gender Inequality Index are associated with which organisation?
o: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs
United Nations Conference on Trade and Development
accepted.x: UNDP releases both the Human Development Index and the Gender Inequality Index.
accepted.tq: Direct organisation–index association.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Human Development Index:
1. The Human Development Report has been published since 1990.
2. The HDI was conceived by Mahbub ul Haq with Amartya Sen.
3. The HDI is released by the World Economic Forum.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the HDI is associated with UNDP, not the World Economic Forum.
accepted.tq: Reject the wrong publisher while retaining historical details about the index.

accepted.s: The Global Gender Gap Index is released by the
accepted.x: The World Economic Forum releases the Global Gender Gap Index.
accepted.tq: Direct publisher recall.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the institutional arrangement for the World Happiness Report?
o: It is associated with the Wellbeing Research Centre, Oxford, in collaboration with Gallup and the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network.
It is published by the World Justice Project with UNCTAD.
It is released solely by the United Nations Development Programme.
It is released by the World Economic Forum with the World Bank.
accepted.x: The World Happiness Report is associated with the Wellbeing Research Centre at Oxford and is produced with Gallup and the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise institutional consortium rather than a familiar international organisation.

accepted.s: The World Happiness Report has been published since
accepted.x: The World Happiness Report has been published since 2012.
accepted.tq: Year-based recall using closely spaced distractors.

accepted.s: The World Press Freedom Index is released by
accepted.x: The World Press Freedom Index is released by Reporters Without Borders, abbreviated as RSF.
accepted.tq: Separate the index publisher from other organisations associated with press freedom.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below:

List-I (Report)
 a. V-Dem Democracy Report
 b. Asia Power Index 2025
 c. Global Risks Report 2026
 d. World Investment Report

List-II (Organisation)
 i. Lowy Institute
 ii. UNCTAD
 iii. V-Dem Institute, University of Gothenburg
 iv. World Economic Forum

option_a: a–iii, b–i, c–iv, d–ii
option_b: a–i, b–iii, c–ii, d–iv
option_c: a–iv, b–ii, c–i, d–iii
option_d: a–ii, b–iv, c–iii, d–i
accepted.x: The V-Dem Democracy Report is associated with the V-Dem Institute at the University of Gothenburg; the Asia Power Index 2025 with the Lowy Institute; the Global Risks Report 2026 with the World Economic Forum; and the World Investment Report with UNCTAD.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure report–publisher pairs and eliminate the remaining codes.

accepted.s: The World Economic Situation and Prospects 2026 is released by which organisation?
accepted.x: The World Economic Situation and Prospects 2026 is released by the United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs (UN DESA).
accepted.tq: Distinguish UN DESA from other UN bodies dealing with the global economy.

accepted.s: Where is the headquarters of the United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs, the publisher of the World Economic Situation and Prospects 2026, located?
accepted.x: UN DESA is based in New York.
accepted.tq: Location-based identification of the responsible institution.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: World Inequality Report 2026 — World Inequality Lab
accepted.x: The World Inequality Report 2026 is released by the World Inequality Lab.
accepted.tq: Publisher matching with nearby economic institutions as distractors.

accepted.s: The QS World Future Skills Index 2027 is published by
accepted.x: The QS World Future Skills Index 2027 is published by QS, or Quacquarelli Symonds.
accepted.tq: Use the exact official publisher name rather than a similar ranking agency.

accepted.s: The World Competitiveness Ranking is released by which institution?
accepted.x: The World Competitiveness Ranking is released by IMD in Lausanne.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the IMD ranking and the WEF competitiveness report.

accepted.s: Which of the following reports is NOT released by the World Bank?
accepted.x: The International Migration Outlook 2025 is released by the OECD. The Logistics Performance Index, Human Capital Index and Global Economic Prospects are associated with the World Bank.
accepted.tq: Find the one report belonging to a different international organisation.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below:

List-I (Report)
 a. World Development Report 2025
 b. International Migration Outlook 2025
 c. Digital Economy Report
 d. Global Investment Trends Monitor

List-II (Publisher)
 i. OECD
 ii. UNCTAD
 iii. World Bank

option_a: a–iii, b–i, c–ii, d–ii
option_b: a–i, b–iii, c–ii, d–iii
option_c: a–ii, b–i, c–iii, d–iii
option_d: a–iii, b–ii, c–i, d–i
accepted.x: The World Development Report 2025 is published by the World Bank; the International Migration Outlook 2025 by the OECD; and both the Digital Economy Report and Global Investment Trends Monitor by UNCTAD.
accepted.tq: Use the repeated UNCTAD pair and the sure World Bank pair to identify the code.

accepted.s: Which organisation released the Digital Economy Report and the Global Investment Trends Monitor?
accepted.x: Both the Digital Economy Report and the Global Investment Trends Monitor are released by UNCTAD.
accepted.tq: Direct identification of a common publisher for two reports.

accepted.s: The World Investment Report is released by
accepted.x: UNCTAD releases the World Investment Report.
accepted.tq: Report–agency recall using closely related economic bodies as distractors.

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. Global Risks Report 2026 — World Economic Forum
2. World Social Protection Report — ILO
3. World Risk Index — UNU-EHS
4. World Future Skills Index 2027 — QS
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched: the World Economic Forum releases the Global Risks Report 2026, ILO the World Social Protection Report, UNU-EHS the World Risk Index, and QS the World Future Skills Index 2027.
accepted.tq: Confirm multiple precise publisher–report associations before selecting the complete combination.
